title: Ae ghuncha dahan bekas dulha
body:
Ae ghuncha dahan bekas dulha, Ae seeeme badan bekas dulha
mujre ke liye aayi hai utho , naashaad dulhan bekas dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
Dunya se nayi ye shaadi hai, dono'n hi taraf barbaadi hai
shabbir ki beti bewa dulhan , aur ibne hasan bekas dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
ye be qabari mujh se qasim, chilte hai mere pohnche qasim
khulwaado ke uljhi jaati hai , kangne me rasan bekas dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai qouf mujhe naaraz na ho, marzi hai tumhaari kya bolo
mai haath me ab kangna rakhu , ya rakhu rasan bekas dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
hum naam hu mai bhi daadi ki, hai tum ko qasam is shaadi ki
banwaado mujhe bhi rone ko, ek baitul hazan bekas dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
tha mujh ko tumhaare ghar chalna, laazim tha tumhei'n mil kar chalna
raste hi me mujh ko chord gaye , hai door watan bekas dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
sab kehte hai mujh ko ab bewa, batlaao mujhe ye baat hai kya
jo log mujhi ko kehte the kal shab ko dulhan bekas dulha
